sn12.67:1.1: The two great arahants often engaged each other in erudite Dhamma discussions for their own enjoyment or the education of their students. | Mahākoṭṭhita was said to be foremost in the methods of textual analysis (AN 1.218:1.1), exemplified by such discussions as MN 43. His verse is at Thag 1.2:0.4.
sn12.67:1.4: This is a rare case where this set of four alternatives is not proposed by a non-Buddhist.
sn12.67:4.3: For the mutual conditioning of name and form with consciousness see SN 12.65:2.16 and notes there.
sn12.67:5.1: Koṭṭhita presses Sāriputta on this point, making sure that students understand the problem and its solution.
